items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: Billie Holiday named him Prez. Billie Holiday said, 'He is the President of the Tenor Saxophone.'

ctx.x: him. "Hey, man, what have you heard from Les? When Basie gonna be comin' back?" You know what I mean? I said, "I don't know, man, when they're coming back. But you'll see placards on the bulletin board when they come in." "Yeah, man, I want to hear that cat, man. That cat is something, the tenor player."

So that's the way it went on, you know. And from then on, it was Prez. Then Billie Holiday named him Prez. Billie Holiday said, "He is the President of the Tenor Saxophone." So there ain't no question about it. And he was. Hawk and them could play, but Hawk and them played that slow tenor. To me... It was all right. Ballads. Hawk on a ballad, he was fine to me. But if you put a tune up in tempo, he was jagged. He wasn't smooth like Prez. You got "Clap Hands, Here Comes Charlie." Smooth. See how smooth he played…
That's interesting. King Oliver said he liked him, and he told Red Allen about him.
